mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_requests (operation_code,actor_sub,request_id,request_hash,state,created_at) VALUES (#{operationCode},#{actorSub},#{requestId},#{requestHash},'PROCESSING',#{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.select: SELECT id,operation_code,actor_sub,request_id,request_hash,state,resource_type,resource_id, response_status,response_body AS response_body_json,created_at,completed_at FROM idempotency_requests WHERE operation_code=#{operationCode} AND actor_sub=#{actorSub} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE idempotency_requests SET state='COMPLETED',resource_type=#{resourceType},resource_id=#{resourceId}, response_status=#{responseStatus},response_body=#{responseBodyJson},completed_at=#{completedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND state='PROCESSING'
